summary: Learn CMMC levels, domains, practices, and assessment concepts in PECB CMMC Foundations training. Prepare for the one-hour exam.
audienceIntro: PECB CMMC Foundations is designed for people who need a foundation in the CMMC model, its assessment process, and its place in the supply chain. It suits those entering or supporting the CMMC ecosystem, including suppliers preparing to work with CMMC requirements.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
